description: Marks the repo's hand-written .js (wwwroot studio modules + tests/js) as ES modules for Node's built-in test runner, and carries the e2e + vendoring scripts. NO npm dependencies and no node_modules: browser libs are vendored under wwwroot/js/studio/vendor (see `vendor:icons`), and playwright is a developer-machine prerequisite the e2e harness resolves globally. .NET ignores this file.
